components.component: CIA Factbook input used by infant mortality
components.rights_decision: The bounded source identifies CIA Factbook, Country Comparisons, 2014, but includes no separate dataset license statement. The output redistributes only the inherited aggregate histogram; the exact input is retained privately in this isolated work package for reproducibility. No additional license claim is made.

The bounded citation identifies the Journal of Statistics Education data archive for data through 2009 and Wikipedia for later values, but includes no separate consolidated dataset license statement. The output contains only aggregate bin counts. No additional license claim is made.

The bounded source gives the factual scope and loads openintro::marathon but supplies no separate external citation or dataset license. The output contains only inherited plotted facts and summaries. No additional license claim is made.
The twenty values are literal in the CC BY-SA source producer; the output is an aggregate box plot.
Only numeric colors and resulting vector geometry inherited from the source PDFs are redistributed. No OpenIntro package binary or source is bundled.

No font program is embedded or redistributed. Helvetica remains a standard base-14 reference. The two figures that depended on ZapfDingbats data glyphs now use explicit vector marker outlines at the exact inherited coordinates.
